findings.desc: doc-code-drift: The Machine Baseline Schema section says the baseline JSON is intentionally small and stable and then lists top-level fields, but it omits createdAt even though experiments/baselines/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline-v1.json has createdAt at line 5. Document createdAt or make the schema list explicitly non-exhaustive so the decision doc stays synchronized with the JSON.
